checks.result: passed; clean build and all 105 tests, 0 failures

acceptance_evidence.reference: The independent final scenario launches the built DiskStewardApp in UI-smoke mode and the built disk-witness-mcp connector, captures a live disk snapshot, drives the status-board/export routes, round-trips settings and retention caps, detects a real watched-root file while excluding a configured subtree, proves exact fixture process/file/task attribution with causal references, proves denied-permission unknown fallback, removes generated sensitive values, integrity-checks a basename-only evidence bundle, queries provenance through all seven read-only MCP tools with no delete surface or forbidden keys, evaluates a healthy declared resource sample, and verifies stopped-service recovery fails closed. A clean compile plus all 105 tests and the Xcode scheme build pass.

discovered_risks: No live Endpoint Security event is claimed because Apple entitlement, release signing, activation approval, and Full Disk Access are unavailable on this host.
The generated Swift-package DiskSteward scheme requires an explicit macOS destination from command-line Xcode; the macOS-targeted build passes.
Signed-artifact idle/load CPU and resident-memory measurements, notarization, upgrade, activation, deactivation, and clean-host uninstall remain release-stage evidence.
